office: the Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security; abroad, Namibia's missions
note: The Ministry's executive director's statement as The Namibian reported it (26 July 2021): a 47-page passport valid ten years at N$400 (doubled), N$800 to replace a lost or damaged one (not modelled). Abroad the Embassy in Brussels charges €25.00 for a new or renewed passport, a fee in euros that isn't summed with the dollar fee, so the abroad route is left unpaid. The Ministry's site resets the connection for this client. Processing times are a lead.

sources.title: The Namibian, 70 000 uncollected ID cards at home affairs (26 July 2021)
sources.said: The renewal of lost and damaged passports will now cost N$800, which is twice the original fee. ... “The number of pages in a passport booklet has increased from 32 to 47, and the validity period has increased from five to 10 years. With the price of a passport being N$400, one is basically paying N$40 per year. This necessitated the doubling of passport fees,” he said.

sources.title: Embassy of Namibia to Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg and the European Union, Visa/Permit/Passport Fees
sources.said: New / Renewed Namibian Passport €25.00 Lost / Damaged Namibian Passport €50.00
